eu-oversize-weekly-2026-w45.approvedText:
Toll costs are moving in two directions across Europe, and route and quote planning for oversize and special transport needs to keep up.

In DAJC's weekly briefing for 2-8 November 2026, two items stand out: Czechia's proposed truck toll increase from July 2027, and a temporary 22.3% cut in the Dutch truck charge until 31 December 2026. The Czech item is a proposal, not yet a final rule, so it's worth tracking before it reaches your pricing.

For dispatchers, carriers and oversize drivers, charges like these feed directly into cost calculations, contract terms and corridor choices, especially for heavy and slow-moving combinations where each kilometre counts.

The full Weekly goes further, with the lead reports and an operator checklist to help you turn the news into practical next steps.

Read the complete article on DAJC.eu: https://www.dajc.eu/news/eu-oversize/eu-oversize-weekly-2026-w45
